pages.title: Getting Blueprints
pages.text: Two ways:$(br)$(li)$(l)Scan$() your own builds with the $(item)Structure Scanner$() (right-click two corners, scan with a $(item)Blank Blueprint Disc$() anywhere in your inventory)$(li)$(l)Find$() curated written $(item)Blueprint Discs$() in $(l)any structure chest$(), plus $(l)archaeology$() brushing sites$(br2)Server operators can also import $(l).schem$() / $(l).litematic$() / $(l).nbt$() files with $(o)/mc3dprint import$().

pages.title: Never the Same Twice
pages.text: With $(o)noDuplicateBlueprints$() on (the default), loot won't hand you a build you already have. Every chest that rolls a disc gives you one you've $(l)never found$(), until you've found them $(l)all$() - then discovery starts a new cycle and they can turn up again.$(br2)Whether that set is $(l)shared$() or $(l)per-player$() follows your library: with the default shared $(item)Blueprint Repository$() the whole server works through one set together (anyone can re-burn what anyone found). Set $(o)blueprintRepositoryIsShared = false$() and each player collects their own.$(br2)Blueprints drop from a qualifying container at a base $(l)40%$(). Scale that with $(o)[loot]$() $(o)blueprintChanceMultiplier$() (1.0 by default), or turn the no-repeat rule off with $(o)noDuplicateBlueprints$().

pages.title: Operator Tools
pages.text: $(o)/mc3dprint discovered list$() shows how many builds are found and how many are still out there.$(br2)$(o)/mc3dprint discovered add <build>$() marks one as already found - useful on a world that predates this system, where discs sitting in a chest were never catalogued.$(br2)$(o)/mc3dprint discovered reseed$() re-syncs from the $(item)Blueprint Repository$() after you deposit a batch.$(br2)$(o)/mc3dprint discovered reset$() clears the ledger so everything is findable again.

pages.title: Discs in Creative
pages.text: In $(l)Creative$(), MC3DPrint can list $(l)every$() curated $(item)Blueprint Disc$() it ships, or just a small hand-picked launch set, your call. Toggle it in $(o)mc3dprint-common.toml$():$(br)$(o)[general]$()$(br)$(o)allowAllDiscsInCreative$()$(br2)Cosmetic only: survival still finds every build as $(l)world loot$() either way.

pages.title: Scan Size
pages.text: The $(item)Structure Scanner$() caps each axis at $(l)33$() by default. Capturing something $(l)bigger$()? Set$(br)$(o)[scanner]$()$(br)$(o)unlockScannerSize = true$()$(br)in $(o)mc3dprint-common.toml$() to scan up to the largest printable size (51 with a $(l)Tier 8$() fabricator).

pages.title: Cross-mod builds
pages.text: Some curated builds use $(l)another mod's blocks$() and only appear when that mod is installed. The $(l)Coppertide Park$() set (a geyser lagoon, drop tower, lazy river, glass serpentine, pendulum half-pipe, and four-lane racer) is built from $(item)MC Waterslides$() blocks: install that mod and the six park discs join creative and $(l)world loot$(); without it they stay hidden. Print costs derive from its recipes automatically.
